verdict.rationale: Supabase's llms.txt points agents to an OpenAPI 3.0 spec for the Management API at supabase.com/openapi.json, covering organizations, projects, branches and configuration. A hands-on probe confirmed that URL returns HTTP 200 with an "openapi" key, so the spec is downloadable. Missing for 10: no evidence of a downloadable OpenAPI spec for each project's auto-generated data APIs (REST/GraphQL), and no independent community corroboration of using the spec.
